jobs_lock_state_check.name: jobs_lock_state_check
jobs_lock_state_check.value: ("jobs"."status" = 'running' and "jobs"."locked_by" is not null and "jobs"."locked_at" is not null and "jobs"."heartbeat_at" is not null) or ("jobs"."status" <> 'running' and "jobs"."locked_by" is null and "jobs"."locked_at" is null and "jobs"."heartbeat_at" is null)

outbox_events_lock_state_check.name: outbox_events_lock_state_check
outbox_events_lock_state_check.value: ("outbox_events"."status" = 'processing' and "outbox_events"."locked_by" is not null and "outbox_events"."locked_at" is not null) or ("outbox_events"."status" <> 'processing' and "outbox_events"."locked_by" is null and "outbox_events"."locked_at" is null)

system_settings_value_storage_check.name: system_settings_value_storage_check
system_settings_value_storage_check.value: (("system_settings"."value_json" is not null)::int + ("system_settings"."encrypted_value" is not null)::int) = 1

system_settings_encryption_key_check.name: system_settings_encryption_key_check
system_settings_encryption_key_check.value: ("system_settings"."encrypted_value" is null and "system_settings"."key_id" is null) or ("system_settings"."encrypted_value" is not null and "system_settings"."key_id" is not null)
